messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Human Exon CDF
parts:
On Mon, Mar 7, 2011 at 6:04 PM, Fong <fongch...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> Does anyone know what happened to the "HuEx-1_0-st-
> v2,coreR3,A20071112,EP" cdf file that was previously available on the
> chiptypes page (http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/HuEx-1_0-st-v2).

Follow the links under "The following subpages contain custom CDFs
that map the exon array probes to gene models" on the same page.

> There appears to be a new cdf file called "HuEx-1_0-st-v2,HB20080710.acs".  Is this equivalent to the "HuEx-1_0-st-
> v2,coreR3,A20071112,EP"?

No. An ACS file is not a CDF file. An Aroma Cell Sequence (ACS) file
contains information of the 25-mer sequence on the chip. A Chip
Definition File (CDF) file contains mapping information how cells
(probes) should be grouped together to measure different genomic units
of interest.

Hope this helps

/Henrik
